Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><div style=\"font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)\"><span style=\"line-height:0\">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
